GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_SHA_ZHAO_TUI_YAN.title: Killer Move Deduction
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_SHA_ZHAO_TUI_YAN.descri: Choose any number of Gu cards. If they match a killer move recipe, consume the selected materials and add the corresponding killer move to your hand; otherwise, if you have enough Energy, pay the costs of the selected cards and automatically play them in order. If you do not have enough Energy, take {Backlash} damage that cannot be Blocked. NL After being played, return this card to your hand. It does not count toward your hand size limit.
